rule_sets.notes: The result sheet states no rules. MoMS 15.12.1.8 makes the standard Trial rules the default unless SRs say otherwise; the 2025 SRs were not available (only the 2026 Melrose Classic SRs). The 2026 rule book is applied to a 2025 event.

entries.notes: No machine printed for this rider.

totals.note: The 'Total' column prints 54; the 'Score' column prints DNF.

entries.notes: Only rider in Junior. NC is printed in the place column. The page shows name, machine and the 0/1/2/3/5 counts only. The sheet does not say whether NC is due to licence, machine (the Classic SRs make modern machines non-competitive) or class.

totals.note: Only the mark counts are visible. The marks, lap totals, Total and Score cells are blank on the page.

tie_break.label: 11 cleans
tie_break.detail: Equal on 33 with Mick LUSCOMBE (8 cleans). The sheet prints no reason; the printed mark counts give this order.

tie_break.label: 8 cleans
tie_break.detail: Equal on 33 with Bryce SQUIBB (11 cleans). The sheet prints no reason; the printed mark counts give this order.

rows.note: No score is visible; the score cell is blank on the page.

misfits.what: Equal totals (33, ranks 9 and 10 in Trial 4) are separated with no printed reason; the reason can only be read off the printed mark counts. row.tie_break has no flag to say the rule was inferred rather than printed.
misfits.suggestion: Add tie_break.inferred (boolean) or tie_break.evidence: printed | derived.

misfits.what: NC on a Tasmanian sheet can come from a non-competitive licence (SRs 16.4) or from a modern machine at a Classic (SRs 12.1). The sheet prints only NC, so standing.reason is not-stated, but the candidate reasons are known and cannot be listed.
misfits.suggestion: Allow standing.possible_reasons[] or a free-text standing.note for 'one of licence or machine'.

misfits.what: A DNF row prints its observation total in the 'Total' column and DNF in the 'Score' column, and simply has no row for the laps not ridden. The protocol can hold this (observation set, total null), but nothing says whether a missing part total means 'not reached' or 'not published'.
misfits.suggestion: Document that an absent part total means the part was not reached, or add total.status 'not-reached'.

misfits.what: The NC rider's marks, totals and score are blank on the page but still present in the PDF text layer (hidden text), while the 0/1/2/3/5 counts stay visible. standing.scores_public=false says the scores are not public, but the protocol cannot say that some derived values (counts) were published while the scores were withheld, or that the withheld values are recoverable from the file.
misfits.suggestion: Replace scores_public with a published-fields list (e.g. standing.published: ['counts']) and add document-level 'hidden_content' so mappers can record that a file carries values the publisher chose not to show, without copying them.

mapping.unread: Nothing unread. Both pages were read through pdftotext and visually (80 dpi render); values hidden in the text layer were not encoded. The 17 riders outside the original sample were added later by parsing the text layer; the parser's output matched all 6 hand-mapped riders with visible scores.
